about: What this file is: the people test's shot-check file (tests/fixtures/people-test/people-test-shot-check.json, from film-kit/examples/people-test/shot-check.json) with the painting keys paint_request.py reads added by the painting-tools helper (log 35): "figures" (the groups that are people), "paint_as" (a person's words, copied from the prompt the people test sent, people-test-paintings.json) and "hollow".
subject: brazier

paint_as.brazier: the rusty brazier drum with its open top, dull dark rust-brown, with only a faint orange glow low inside
paint_as.lamp post: every gas lamp with warm amber glass and a small bright mantle inside
paint_as.chimney: the colliery's tall chimney, the two winding wheels and their headgear
paint_as.gates: the colliery building with its board and its shut iron gates
